claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemComponentMechanics.ongoing_effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core activated mechanic is not an immediate effect. Activating it creates a temporary armed weapon state that persists for 1 minute or until the next hit with that specific weapon, then resolves a save-gated payload on that later hit. Existing magic-item families allow immediate activation, passive grants, triggered reactions, or summons, but not an activated timed state with later on-hit resolution.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature.
